about_the_game:
A small add-on for Ultimate Fishing Simulator, introducing as many as 16 new species of fish - from small freshwater fish to the long-awaited tuna!

Fish species available in the DLC:
  1. Asp,
  2. Black grayling,
  3. Common bleak,
  4. Burbot,
  5. Flathead catfish,
  6. Giant trevally,
  7. Ide,
  8. Pumpkinseed,
  9. Roach,
  10. Sailfish,
  11. Gilthead seabream,
  12. Silver bream,
  13. Silver carp,
  14. White crappie,
  15. Grayling,
  16. Yellowfin tuna,
